description:
Stories

Homer the Happy Ghost- Homer the Happy Ghost and his family move into their new haunted house. Homer then meet the neighborhood ghosts including Dugan the bully, Melvin the mixed-up ghost, Invisible Irwin and Zelda the Scatter-Brained Witch. The yet unnamed Ghost Gang gets into mischief before Homer goes back home.

Melvin, The Mixed-up Ghost- Melvin's mom sends him out for ice cream but when Melvin doesn't come home Ma and Pa begin to worry.

Homer the Happy Ghost- Homer and Dugan are tasked with getting Zelda's magic flying broom from Gobby the Goblin, but they end up making things worse for Zelda.

Momma and Poppa Ghost- Momma tries to wake Poppa up so he can get a job and stop bothering her at the haunted house.

Invisible Irwin- Irwin has a very good reason for not helping Homer with a simple task.

Melvin, The Mixed-up Ghost- Dugan takes Melvin's last dime and leads Melvin down a path that sees him become an accidental bank robber.

Snappy The Ghost Dog- Snappy begins his adventures of confounding Dog Catchers.

Dugan the Dead-end Ghost- Dugan gives a pep talk to the only ghost he likes, himself.

Homer the Happy Ghost- Homer races Dugan in a sled race that turns into a submarine race due to Dugan's trickery.

Homer the Happy Ghost- Homer and Invisible Irwin follow a hobo and join the circus but things go sour when no one but the hobo believes Homer and Irwin are ghosts.

Zelda ,the Scatter Brained Witch- Zelda brews a powerful spell, or a so-so soup.

Homer the Happy Ghost- Homer falls asleep while reading Jack and the Beanstalk. He dreams of going up the beanstalk meeting the youngest giant and his father the shortest giant, and learns that their life is not much different then his.
